name: Eyepiece
summary: Observatory sign-in: Saturn comes into focus as you type, a lens cap hides your password, clouds roll in
about: A full sign-in page for a night sky club on the Deosai plains, with a glass form beside a live telescope view: a turning bezel, a reticle, Saturn out of focus, a starry canvas sky over layered mountains and a little observatory dome. Every letter of your email sharpens the focus and adds a star to a constellation arcing over the eyepiece; the password puts the lens cap on. A wrong password rolls clouds across the view, and signing in locks the target, lights the constellation and sends a comet across the sky.
how: Watch the demo focus the telescope by itself, then click any field to take over
Type an email: the view sharpens, the bezel turns and each letter adds a star to the constellation
Click the password: the lens cap slides on; the eye button tilts it for a peek
Try a wrong password for clouds, or use Fill it in (sana@eyepiece.pk, ringworld9) to lock on Saturn
Join the club counts password rules as stars; the reset code is 731905
